What Are B2B List Building Services?

B2B list-building services are tailored solutions designed for businesses seeking to generate high-quality sales leads. These b2b list-building services are often used to create prospect databases based on your targeted ideal customer profile (ICP), extracting the required decision-maker information such as email addresses, phone numbers, job titles, and company details. This helps your internal sales and marketing teams to run personalized, impactful outreach campaigns, saving expensive time and increasing conversions. 

Features of MarketJoy’s B2B List Building Services 

The Customized list is built from scratch, targeting specific verticals within companies, company sizes, geographies, and decision-makers that are relevant to your business. We prioritize buyer intent data and advanced research tools that are data driven to identify prospects who are most likely to engage.

With our proprietary tool, MarketJoy can tell you who your future customers are today by identifying intent signals across your Ideal Client Profile.

Data is only as good as your ability to engage with it. By providing Direct Dial numbers you see an increase in call connections and, subsequently, conversions. Giving your team more ‘at-bats’ through our Direct Dial service.

We source data that is verified from professional networks, business directories, social media, and proprietary research, making sure every contact is accurate and up to date.

Provided Lists are verified for spam safety, accuracy, and in compliance with required standards reducing bounce rates and protecting sender reputation.

From market research to validation, market segmentation to delivery, MarketJoy’s experts manage every stage, so your team can focus on closing targeted deals and not manual data labor.

We provide Transparent collaborations with a dedicated MarketJoy account manager who provides timely updates on our custom list building services campaign performance.

We make sure to enhance your existing lists, filling gaps and removing outdated or duplicate contacts for maximum impact. We also augment existing lists with direct dial cell phone numbers to increase your ability to reach them.

100% Data Verification

Every contact is researched, verified, and validated by our team of experts and they are never auto scraped. This ensures you receive quality leads that are accurate, relevant, and tailored to your needs.

Transparent, Ethical Approach

We prioritize Updates, clarity, and compliance that are at the heart of everything we do. We strictly follow the latest privacy, accuracy, and trustworthiness guidelines from data collection to client communications.

What is Buyer Intent?

Buyer intent is the term used for the ability to identify contacts based on various intent signals. These can be questions poised through social media, content accessed, job postings, and around 5,000 various touch points. This provides you with the ability to identify contacts within your ideal client profile that are also engaged with content related to your products/services.

How to improve your teams call connection rate?

The only way to ensure that your Inside Sales and Sales team(s) connect with more people is to provide them with Direct Dial numbers. These are direct lines, often cell numbers, that provide your team with the added advantage of simply speaking to more people.

Without Direct Dials your team gets bogged down in phone tress and Receptionists.

Frequently Asked Questions

What industries do you specialize in?

MarketJoy serves a wide range of industries and firms, right from SaaS, IT and technology, fintech and finance, business consulting, manufacturing, shipping and logistics and more, with custom list building tailored to your unique buyer personas. 

What makes your prospect list building services different from buying a pre-built list?

Our prospect list building services are 100% human-verified based on your provided specific targeting criteria. Unlike pre-built lists, ours are up-to-date, human-verified, and designed to convert right from the start. 

What happens if some leads are not accurate?

If any of the provided data is invalid or unreachable in the process, we’ll promptly replace them at no extra charge, ensuring that you always have actionable data. 

How do you guarantee data accuracy?

Each contact undergoes a multi-step verification process, including human review, to ensure data accuracy. We verify emails, clean lists for outdated and duplicate contacts, and update records regularly.

How is MarketJoy different from other custom list building companies?

Unlike other data providers, we use our data for, and with, our clients. We provide direct dial numbers, validated emails and we guarantee every contact, or it will be replaced at no cost.  

Can I specify exactly whom I want to target?

Absolutely. MarketJoy’s custom list building services are designed around your precise provided criteria that may be industry, title, company size, region, and more. 

What is prospect list building?

Prospect list building is the process of creating a customized database of potential customers who match with your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). It involves identifying decision-makers & segmenting them based on factors like industry, firms, company size, job role & buyer intent signals.

How much does the lead list building cost?

The cost of lead list building depends on various factors, such as the volume of contacts, the level of customization required, industry niche & the initial depth of data required (e.g., direct dials, buyer intent insights, lead enrichment). We offer flexible, ROI-driven pricing models that are designed to fit your campaign goals.
